models.why: Liquid AI's own figures relayed by FHILY: 184 t/s on an Apple M5 Max and 114 t/s on an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Strix Halo; Q4 GGUF is ~14.5GB and fits an 8GB card with expert layers offloaded; leads Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on LiveClaw (48.1 vs 38.2) and AutomationBench (27.7 vs 8.7)

engines.quant: vendor-reported figure; quantization not stated in the post (Q4_K_M GGUF is ~14.5GB, fits an 8GB card with experts offloaded to CPU)
